name: npm/firecrawl-mcp
title: Firecrawl
description: Advanced web scraping with JavaScript rendering, PDF support, and smart rate limiting

toolsSummary.name: firecrawl_scrape
toolsSummary.description: Scrape a single URL with formats (markdown, HTML, links, screenshots) and options.

toolsSummary.name: firecrawl_map
toolsSummary.description: Map a website to discover indexed URLs and structure.

toolsSummary.name: firecrawl_crawl
toolsSummary.description: Crawl from a start URL with depth/limits; poll status with the companion check tool when used.

io.sami/gallery.about: Firecrawl turns websites into clean, model-friendly data: scrape, map, and crawl with JS rendering and rate limiting via the cloud API (API key) or a self-hosted instance.

environmentVariables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Firecrawl API key. Required for using the cloud API (default) and optional for self-hosted instances.
